Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
As the Head of State and Local Government Sales at Anthropic, you'll lead and scale our state and local government sales organization to drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across state agencies, counties, cities, and other local government entities throughout the United States. You'll leverage your deep understanding of state and local government operations and proven sales leadership expertise to build a high-performing team while establishing strategic relationships with key states, municipalities, and public sector partners. Working closely with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll define and execute our go-to-market strategy for the state and local government sector while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance.

Build, lead, and scale a state and local government sales team, including hiring top talent, setting clear performance expectations, and providing ongoing coaching and development
Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies for state and local government, including territory design, market segmentation, competitive positioning, and revenue forecasting across a large and geographically distributed customer base
Own overall state and local government revenue targets and ensure team performance against quotas, while providing visibility into pipeline health and deal progression
Establish and cultivate relationships with governors' offices, state CIOs, agency executives, and city and county leadership, serving as Anthropic's senior point of contact for strategic engagement while empowering your team to own day-to-day customer relationships
Win new business across state and local government by helping state agencies, counties, and cities integrate AI into their technology stacks and constituent-facing and back-office workflows to accelerate delivery and improve service outcomes
Establish and refine sales processes, methodologies, and playbooks specific to state and local procurement, including cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, RFP/RFI processes, and state-specific compliance requirements
Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud service providers, system integrators, and resellers to create scalable go-to-market motions across the state and local market
Synthesize market feedback and customer insights to inform product roadmap and competitive strategy, working closely with product and marketing teams
Partner with legal, compliance, and delivery teams to ensure successful contract execution and customer satisfaction
Implement metrics, reporting, and performance management systems to drive team accountability and continuous improvement
Represent Anthropic at industry events and with key stakeholders, establishing our brand as the trusted AI partner for state and local government
Minimum qualifications
15+ years of enterprise sales experience with 5+ years managing state and local government sales teams, with a proven track record of scaling revenue and building high-performing organizations

jobs.description: Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through one of the world’s largest and most diverse customer service workforces. As AI fundamentally changes how customer service work is performed, it also creates an opportunity to reinvent how associates learn, develop their capabilities, receive coaching, and continuously improve. The Associate Development team is building the next generation of learning, coaching and performance experiences for Amazon Customer Service Associates. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build these systems from the ground up. This is a highly greenfield opportunity. Rather than digitizing traditional training and coaching processes, we are rethinking how associate development should work in an AI-native world. What does an associate need to learn before doing a job? What can they learn through experience? What should AI provide in the flow of work? How can we understand an associate’s evolving capabilities and use that understanding to personalize development? How can generative AI help provide timely, relevant and effective coaching at the scale of a global workforce? Imagine systems that continuously learn from an associate’s experience and outcomes, identify where they would benefit from development, and deliver personalized learning or AI-powered coaching. The outcomes of those interventions can then become new evidence about the associate, creating a closed loop that gets smarter over time. As an SDE on this team, you will help define and build the technical foundations that make this possible. You will work on problems spanning generative AI, personalization, intelligent recommendations, learning and coaching systems, experimentation, data and distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to influence architecture at an early stage rather than inherit a predetermined technical solution. You will partner closely with Product, Science, UX and engineering teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. The systems you build have the potential to shape how Customer Service Associates around the world develop and succeed at work. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys zero-to-one problems, emerging AI technologies, large-scale systems and building products with direct human impact. Key job responsibilities - Design and build scalable services and experiences that power personalized learning, coaching and associate development across Amazon Customer Service. - Build AI-powered coaching capabilities, including applications of generative AI that can understand context, generate relevant guidance and adapt experiences to individual associate needs. - Develop systems that connect signals about associate capability and performance with the right development intervention at the right time. - Help create closed-loop systems that measure the outcomes of learning and coaching interventions and use that evidence to continuously improve future recommendations. - Work with Product and Science partners to translate emerging models and experimentation into reliable production systems. - Make foundational architectural decisions for a greenfield product space while determining where existing Amazon capabilities can be reused or evolved. - Design APIs, data models and integration patterns that allow Associate Development capabilities to interact with associate context, workflow and other Customer Service systems. - Build mechanisms for experimentation, measurement and observability so we can understand whether the experiences we create actually improve associate and customer outcomes. - Deliver secure, reliable and globally scalable systems while maintaining a high bar for operational excellence. A day in the life You might start the day working with a scientist on how an AI coaching experience can use an associate’s recent performance context to generate more useful coaching. Later, you could whiteboard an architecture for measuring whether that coaching actually changed future performance, review an API contract with another CS platform team, and prototype a new generative-AI capability. Because the space is early, you won’t simply be executing against a fully specified roadmap. You will help answer fundamental technical questions, prototype alternatives, make architecture decisions, and turn successful experiments into production systems capable of serving associates globally. About the team The Associate Experience (AE) team is building the future of work for Amazon Customer Service Associates. Our vision is to create a trusted Customer Service experience by enabling associates to succeed as the role evolves toward complex and non-deterministic problem solving. Within AE, the Associate Development team is reinventing how associates learn, develop and improve, moving beyond one-size-fits-all training and coaching towards, personalized development powered by AI. Engineers joining the team will shape foundational architecture, drive technology choices, and build AI-powered products from the ground up for one of the world's largest customer service workforces.

jobs.description: Alexa is Amazon's AI assistant, and customers have been talking to it for years. They already have a relationship with Alexa and an opinion about who Alexa is. The way Alexa talks, reacts, and connects is central to what makes it distinctive, and we are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the vision for that: who Alexa is, how it engages, and how it makes millions of customers feel understood in every interaction. You will decide what that character becomes next. The work you own shapes every customer conversation, on every device, in every context. Role summary Alexa is a distinct character, and that character is a core part of what makes Alexa valuable to customers. As the Principal PMT for Alexa Personality & EQ, you will define and protect it. You will own the multi-year vision for who Alexa is and how it expresses that identity across every customer interaction: its voice, tone, emotional intelligence, and humor. You will hold two goals in tension, making Alexa feel deeply personalized to each customer while remaining unmistakably and consistently itself. This is a hands-in-the-product role, not a set-strategy-and-hand-off role. You'll author instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship those changes, and iterate week over week. The work demands real technical depth: you will work directly with frontier models, partner with design on how the character is expressed in the experience, and partner closely with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated, operating at the edge of what they can do today. You will translate a subjective, high-judgment question, "who should Alexa be, and how should it feel to interact with Alexa," into a concrete and decomposed strategy that can be applied across Alexa, an explicit and measurable definition of Alexa's emotional intelligence, and shipped experiences. Building the mechanisms to measure that standard is as much of the job as defining it, through to the go/no-go calls on shipping model and prompt changes. These approaches are established and still evolving quickly, which means part of the work is inventing what comes next. Someone expecting pure creative strategy will be surprised by how much rigor this demands. While you own the character strategy, there are many pieces across the technology stack that you will influence (not own), like the deeper technology that produces Alexa's voice and visual rendering. You co-own the quality bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction, and you are accountable for whether the shipped expression is true to Alexa's personality. You are also the steward of keeping Alexa, Alexa, catching updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would dilute the character. Personality is one of the most subjective domains in product development. There is no ground truth and no dataset that tells you who Alexa should be. You will need to push innovative ideas through an organization, and have the backbone to defend a creative point of view when the data is ambiguous and the stakes are high. The right person finds that energizing, not exhausting. Because personality touches every response Alexa gives, this is a horizontal charter: you set the bar and drive many product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority. Key job responsibilities • Define who Alexa is. Own and evangelize the multi-year vision and strategy for Alexa's personality and emotional intelligence, expressed operationally: voice, tone, conversational style, and emotional range. Align leaders behind a single definition that holds across an extremely diverse and vast customer surface area. • Author and ship the instructions that shape how Alexa behaves. Write the character instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship them, and iterate weekly. Partner with design on how the character comes through in the experience, and with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated. • Define and measure the quality bar, and own the ship decisions. Turn subjective qualities like emotional intelligence into evaluable standards, and build the automated judges and annotation rubrics that measure them. Co-own the bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction. Own the calls to ship or hold new model versions and prompt changes, and turn failure patterns in the data into instruction changes the same week. • Own humor and wit as first-class craft. Calibrate joke quality, handle roasts and playful pushback, judge when wit lands, and know when not to be funny. Humor is one of the hardest attributes to get right and one of the most defining. • Protect the character from dilution. Be the backstop that keeps Alexa recognizably Alexa, catching the updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would flatten what makes Alexa distinct. This means holding the bar against cross-team priorities. • Own personalization and the customer-facing controls. Own the product strategy and roadmap for the controls that let people shape how Alexa engages with them, and define how the preferences a customer sets, along with the context of the conversation, shape Alexa's responses. Work with design to define the experience each should produce. • Keep the character trustworthy. Partner with Responsible AI and Trust & Safety so Alexa's personality is appropriate in sensitive contexts and reinforces customer trust. • Look ahead to new forms of expression. Work with design to anticipate the new ways Alexa's character will come through as the experience evolves, and hold the same quality bar wherever it shows up. • Lead horizontally. As the single owner of the bar, drive product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority, and represent Alexa's character in executive-level planning.

jobs.description: Are you ready to be part of Amazon’s most ambitious delivery expansion in Europe? We’re scaling our same-day delivery network across the EU and we need the right people to help us run it successfully. As the network grows, protecting customer promise around the clock becomes critical. That’s where you come in. As EU Speed Initiative Manager in Central Operations, you will own the operational improvements across the entire same-day delivery network. You will lead the team to identify and resolve operational exceptions before they impact customers, and act as the single point of accountability for new initiatives. You will manage and launch new initiatives, improve current operations, and work closely with site operators and cross-functional stakeholders to protect on-time delivery and customer experience performance. We’re looking for individuals who can collaborate effectively with diverse teams, make informed decisions in ambiguous situations, and take ownership of outcomes. You’ll be part of a team that is building the operational backbone for Amazon’s next-generation delivery network, partnering across EU markets every single shift. Key job responsibilities Amazon is building the largest same-day delivery network in Europe — and it's scaling rapidly. The network is expanding across the continent at pace, bringing same-day delivery to millions more customers across multiple European markets. This is one of the most complex logistics transformations happening anywhere in the world right now. Central Operations is the strategic planning hub powering this network — a high-impact function that provides real-time intelligence, capacity strategy, and performance governance across every market. We define how the European network operates, setting the standards, building the technology, and designing the frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality execution at continental scale. We're looking for an EU Central Operations Speed Strategy Lead — a senior individual contributor who will own the end-to-end operational strategy for the most complex and high-visibility initiatives shaping the future of Amazon's European last-mile network. The objective is to help and enable our partners and operation sites to become the fastest delivery network. For this, we need you to work with the program team to define the north start of our operations and, in parallel, work with our team to build new tools, processes, metrics. You will be the single-threaded owner in our team of how these initiatives are conceived, designed, and operationalized at scale. This is not a coordination role. This is a role for a deep strategic thinker who operates with the autonomy, judgement, and influence to shape multi-year network decisions. You will define the "how" and the "what" for initiatives that don't yet have a playbook — building the operational architecture from first principles, influencing senior leadership, and setting the standard that the network will follow. Why This Role • You will own the operational strategy for Amazon's most transformative EU initiatives. When a new Same Day dedicated building type launches in a European market, you will have defined the operating model, capacity framework, and integration architecture that will operate the intra week planning. When the next generation of robotics-enabled fulfilment sites transitions into the AMZL network, your design will determine how Central Operations governs and optimizes them on short term planning and for daily operations. • You will operate with principal-level scope and autonomy. You won't wait for direction — you will set it. You will independently identify the strategic questions that need answering, frame the problem, build the analytical case, and deliver recommendations that shape investment decisions and network design choices at the highest levels. • You will be the technical and strategic Person of Contact within our organization (CO). Teams across planning, engineering, technology, site operations, and senior leadership will look to you as the SME (Subject Matter Expert) for our organizations inputs on how new network concepts should be operationalized. • You will build what doesn't exist yet. There is no established playbook for many of the initiatives you'll lead. You will create the frameworks, models, and standards from scratch — and they will become the foundation for how Last Mile scales its fastest-growing EU network. • You will sit at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operations design. The team builds proprietary real-time optimization platforms. You'll define the strategic requirements that shape what gets built, influence the technology roadmap, and ensure operational strategy and tooling evolve together. A day in the life Your morning starts with a deep review of the latest data from the SSD dedicated building pilot you designed the operational model for — the results are outperforming projections, and you're refining the blueprint before recommending full EU rollout to senior leadership. By mid-morning, you're leading a strategic design session on the operational integration of a new robotics-enabled fulfilment concept, working through the capacity model and governance framework with engineering and planning teams. Over lunch, you're drafting the operational architecture document for a new Last Mile dispatch Program — a first-principles analysis that will define how this initiative operates across four European markets. Every day is different. But every day, you're defining the operational future of Amazon's European delivery network. About the team Central Operations is a new approach within Amazon Logistics to define a scalable solution to run the increasingly complex and growing last-mile delivery network. Central Operations is a key strategic initiative with a vision to transform the way Amazon Logistics executes forecasting, route planning, demand scheduling, and last-mile delivery. The role will provide opportunities to think big, develop original ideas, and partner with Planning, Transportation, Last Mile Technology, Operations, and business expansion teams to develop a strategic approach to scale Central Operations.

職務概要

ビジネスレベルの英語力。

PythonまたはRを活用した高度なデータ分析や業務自動化スクリプト開発の実務経験。

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

직무 소개
최신 AI 기술을 활용하여 지능형 보안 및 리스크 탐지 시스템을 구축할 수 있는 뛰어난 Staff AI Engineer를 찾고 있습니다.
이 포지션에서는 기술 리더 및 보안 도메인 전문가들과 긴밀히 협업하며 AI 기반 조사(Investigation), 탐지(Detection), 자동화(Automation) 시스템의 설계, 개발 및 확장을 담당하게 됩니다. 대규모 운영 및 보안 텔레메트리 데이터를 분석하고, 실행 가능한 인사이트를 도출하며, 보안 의사결정의 속도와 품질을 향상시키는 시스템을 개발하게 됩니다.
본 포지션은 프로토타입 개발이 아닌 실제 운영 환경(Production)에서 동작하는 분산 AI 시스템 구축에 초점을 둔 실무 중심의 엔지니어링 역할입니다. 복잡한 기술적 문제를 해결하는 것을 즐기고, 프로젝트를 처음부터 끝까지 주도적으로 수행하며, 기술 설계를 안정적이고 확장 가능한 소프트웨어로 구현하는 엔지니어를 찾고 있습니다.
업무 내용
AI 기반 조사(Investigation) 시스템 개발
조사 및 분석 업무를 자동화하는 AI 워크플로우를 설계하고 개발합니다.
내부 도구, 데이터 소스 및 지식 저장소와 연계되는 에이전트 기반(Agent-based) 시스템을 구축합니다.
AI 기반 워크플로우의 추론 품질, 안정성 및 성능을 지속적으로 개선합니다.
Human-in-the-loop 기반 검토 및 피드백 메커니즘을 구현합니다.
탐지 및 리스크 분석 시스템 개발
의심스럽거나 고위험 활동을 탐지하기 위한 탐지 로직을 설계하고 구현합니다.
리스크 시그널(Risk Signal), 행동 분석(Behavioral Analytics), 이상 탐지(Anomaly Detection) 기능을 개발합니다.
다양한 텔레메트리 데이터를 결합하여 실행 가능한 인텔리전스로 전환하는 시스템을 구축합니다.
기존 탐지 기능의 품질과 탐지 범위를 지속적으로 개선합니다.
데이터 및 시그널 파이프라인 개발
AI 및 분석 워크로드를 위한 확장 가능한 배치(Batch) 및 스트리밍(Streaming) 데이터 파이프라인을 구축합니다.
